summary: Governance owns generic rule, evidence and route tooling, including pure policy kernels, effect hosts and configuration libraries. Governance CLI execution and enforcement are optional; that does not forbid declared Governance library dependencies. The inspected SDD Commands project references Governance.Config for configuration and capability-binding resolution. Broad README/earlier Atlas wording that SDD must not require any Governance package to build must not erase that actual source dependency. Generic Governance APIs remain consumer-neutral, and source/library adoption is separate from provider execution, installed enforcement or current operation authority.
title: Optional governance and evidence tooling
